dct_description_sm: The collection of electoral results at the level of single constituencies for 18 Western European countries developed jointly with the comparative research on the formation processes of national electorates and party systems in Europe carried out in the framework of a Ph.D. dissertation written at the European University Institute of Florence (see Chapter 3 of the handbook in Part I 'Elections in Comparison').

Data have been collected mainly from official sources. In many cases, especially for the earlier periods, only secondary sources were available. The list of sources contains both types of sources for each country. (https://mdl.library.utoronto.ca/sites/default/public/mdldata/restricted/international/ewes1815/cdrom/fra_sta.htm)

 104 data files (number of logical records varies) & accompanying documentation

dct_title_s: Elections in western Europe since 1815: electoral results by constituencies.
